decision.question: Should a university run a bounded AI-tutor pilot in one high-enrollment module?
decision.baseline: Continue existing teaching and support arrangements without an AI tutor.

escalation_triggers: student data use expands beyond the declared pilot
the system influences grading or formal academic records
model, retrieval source, permissions, vendor terms, or oversight capacity changes
material accessibility, discrimination, privacy, misinformation, or staff-burden evidence appears

evidence_and_claim_boundary.reality_surface: A synthetic one-module university pilot involving enrolled students, teaching staff, approved course materials, one configured AI-tutor service, and university support and governance roles.

evidence_trace.description: Illustrative vendor and configuration documentation for model, retrieval, retention, logging, and permissions
Illustrative university privacy, accessibility, academic-integrity, and procurement review notes
Illustrative teacher-oversight workload and student-support process estimate
Illustrative bounded test protocol for approved-material retrieval, refusal, logging, and escalation

evidence_and_claim_boundary.transition_or_action_boundary: Select whether to remain with current support, adopt an unrestricted general-purpose tutor, or authorize only a bounded non-grading pilot pending separate execution approval.
evidence_and_claim_boundary.claim_boundary: Synthetic Tier 2 reference replay only. It supports no claim that AI tutoring improves learning, is generally safe, or is ready for institutional deployment.

parameters.source: illustrative authority choice fixed before ranking

parameters.not_material_rationale: The packet demonstrates the cascade and authority boundary, not validated cardinal RLS measurement.

parameter_lock.amendment_policy: Any material change creates run version 1.1 and reopens all affected stages.

stakeholders.description: Students, including disabled, multilingual, low-connectivity, and otherwise differently situated subgroups
stakeholders.subgroup: Protected and differently affected student subgroups

stakeholders.description: University academic, privacy, accessibility, procurement, and appeals functions
Wider education ecosystem and future learners affected by dependency or precedent

options.description: Do not deploy an AI tutor; continue current teaching and support arrangements.
Deploy a general-purpose AI tutor with broad data access, open-ended responses, and no dedicated teacher-oversight or appeal controls.

Run an eight-week bounded AI-tutor pilot using instructor-approved materials, no grading authority, privacy and accessibility controls, teacher oversight, student notice, opt-out, appeal, logging, and a stop path.

gate_results.rationale: Known baseline remains selectable; status-quo burdens remain explicit in ranking.
Privacy, accessibility, due-process, academic-fairness, and authority conditions are unresolved; later scoring cannot rescue the option.
Only the bounded configuration is selectable, conditional on constitutive controls, named duties, and separate execution authorization.

ranking.decisiveness_rule: Illustrative structured comparison only; unknown learning benefit, heterogeneous effects, and oversight burden prevent a deterministic framework-selection claim.
ranking.summary: C has the stronger conditional residual-ripple profile if its controls and oversight capacity are real; A remains the fallback and may be preferable under adverse pilot evidence.

decision_state.rationale: A bounded pilot can reduce uncertainty without granting grading authority or unrestricted deployment.
decision_state.authority_selection_rationale: The named academic authority may choose a reversible evidence-generating pilot after the framework reports non-decisiveness; the selection is not an execution mandate.

authority_and_execution.mandate_scope: May select a bounded module pilot subject to university privacy, accessibility, procurement, academic-integrity, and appeals requirements.
authority_and_execution.appeal_path: Students and staff may use the pilot appeal and protected reporting route; unresolved rights or safety concerns pause activation.
authority_and_execution.revocation_path: Academic authority, privacy officer, accessibility lead, or designated safety reviewer may suspend the pilot and return to Option A.

controls_monitoring_and_reopen.shutdown_or_pause_path: Disable the tutor and revert to existing support if a rights, privacy, accessibility, academic-integrity, model-drift, or workload threshold is crossed.
reopen_triggers: student data use expands beyond the declared pilot
the system influences grading or formal academic records
model, retrieval source, permissions, vendor terms, or oversight capacity changes
material accessibility, discrimination, privacy, misinformation, or staff-burden evidence appears

consequence_tempo.trigger_rationale: Illustrative bounded pilot; reopen if propagation speed, automation, irreversibility, emergency conditions, or lock-in becomes material.

responsibility_continuity.execution_authority: Separate university deployment authority; not yet issued
responsibility_continuity.intervention_authority: Module leader, privacy officer, accessibility lead, and designated safety reviewer
responsibility_continuity.remedy_owner: Faculty academic authority with privacy/accessibility functions

material_obligations.obligation: Maintain data minimization, retention, access, and deletion controls required for the bounded pilot.
material_obligations.operational_carrier_or_execution_path: Named data steward and approved platform configuration
material_obligations.authority_and_capacity_basis: University privacy officer has the declared mandate, resources, stop authority, access to records, and escalation route for this bounded illustrative case.
material_obligations.activation_trigger: The selected pilot is approved for activation or a control exception is detected.
material_obligations.scope: One module, approved pilot participants, declared data fields, and pilot period
material_obligations.required_action: Verify minimization and deletion settings, investigate exceptions, and suspend access when the privacy envelope fails.
material_obligations.response_deadline_or_window: Before activation and immediately upon a material exception.
material_obligations.evidence_of_discharge: Configuration record, access log, deletion evidence, and incident register.
material_obligations.review_or_expiry: Review at each scheduled checkpoint; expires at pilot end or on any material configuration, evidence, authority, or environment change.
material_obligations.challenge_route: Student or staff challenge to privacy officer and independent appeal owner.
material_obligations.delegation_acceptance: Any delegate must explicitly accept the duty in the controlled role register before carrying it.
material_obligations.backup_or_successor: Deputy privacy officer or named data steward.
material_obligations.nonperformance_trigger: Missing evidence of discharge, unavailable carrier, unresolved exception, missed response window, or loss of authority/capacity.
material_obligations.missed_duty_escalation: Suspend the tutor, preserve evidence, notify affected parties under applicable rules, and reopen RG/RF/CSV.
material_obligations.amendment_waiver_suspension_retirement_a: University privacy officer with independent reviewer sign-off; the operating carrier may not self-waive.
material_obligations.change_control_rule: Any material amendment, waiver, suspension, or replacement must be logged and independently reviewed; changed conditions reopen affected MathGov stages.
material_obligations.residual_responsibility: The deploying institution retains residual responsibility and may not transfer it to a vendor, contractor, or automated system.

human_compensation_load.trigger_rationale: The bounded system may appear capable partly because teachers and support staff review, correct, explain, and absorb exceptions.
human_compensation_load.hidden_work_and_workflow_gap: Review, correction, student reassurance, accessibility adjustment, and exception handling may be omitted from headline efficiency claims.
human_compensation_load.single_person_dependency: Pilot must not depend on one teacher holding the only complete exception knowledge.
human_compensation_load.consequence_if_compensation_stops: Unsupported answers, unresolved appeals, inaccessible support, or academic-integrity failures may continue while the system appears operational.
human_compensation_load.privacy_and_non_retaliation_controls: Aggregate workload reporting, confidential reporting, no retaliation for stopping or challenging the pilot, and student privacy protection.
human_compensation_load.preservation_or_redesign_action: Resource the oversight work, preserve protected reporting and backup roles, cap pilot scale, and pause expansion when burden or recovery thresholds fail.
human_compensation_load.review_trigger: Any proposed activation, scaling, reduction in oversight staffing, repeated manual override, or material workload/recovery signal.

configuration_assurance.operating_envelope: One module, eight weeks, approved materials, declared students and staff, no grading or formal-record changes, no autonomous external tool use.

capability_authority_decomposition_recor.candidate_generation_method: A probabilistic language model generates candidate explanations and practice prompts from the approved course context.
capability_authority_decomposition_recor.reference_source: Instructor-approved course materials, named learning objectives, and the current student request.
capability_authority_decomposition_recor.objective_source: Faculty academic authority and module learning objectives.
capability_authority_decomposition_recor.objective_change_authority: Faculty academic authority through logged change control and requalification.
capability_authority_decomposition_recor.execution_interface: Student-facing tutor interface with audit logging; no external consequential tools.
capability_authority_decomposition_recor.execution_scope: Generate bounded learning-support outputs inside one module; no grading, enrollment, discipline, formal records, or external actions.
capability_authority_decomposition_recor.execution_authority_source: No execution mandate is issued by this packet; activation requires a separate university deployment authorization.
capability_authority_decomposition_recor.revocation_authority: Module leader, privacy officer, accessibility lead, faculty authority, or designated safety reviewer.
capability_authority_decomposition_recor.safe_state_or_shutdown_path: Disable the tutor and revert to existing human support while preserving logs and appeal access.
capability_authority_decomposition_recor.requalification_trigger: Model, retrieval corpus, permissions, data use, authority, oversight capacity, user population, or operating envelope changes.
capability_authority_decomposition_recor.operational_definition: Within the declared configuration, the system can generate context-sensitive explanations and practice prompts from instructor-approved material, subject to teacher oversight, refusal, logging, and a stop path.
observable_criteria: uses only the approved corpus and declared interface
does not grade or alter formal records
produces logged outputs available for review
routes challenges and material uncertainty to a human
stops when a binding control or scope condition fails
capability_authority_decomposition_recor.mechanism_or_system_composition: Probabilistic language model, retrieval over an approved corpus, policy and permission controls, audit logging, student interface, teacher review, accessibility support, appeals, and institutional authority.
validity_conditions: Active privacy, accessibility, oversight, appeal, and stop controls
alternative_explanations: Template retrieval rather than general tutoring capability
Hidden teacher correction producing apparent quality
capability_authority_decomposition_recor.falsification_or_revision_trigger: Material scope violation, failure to use approved sources, inability to refuse or escalate, inaccessible output, unbounded oversight burden, or any configuration/domain change.
capability_authority_decomposition_recor.permitted_claim: The selected configuration is designed as a bounded AI-assisted learning-support pilot under human oversight; it has not been authorized or shown to improve learning.
explicit_nonclaims: physical or psychological safety beyond the stated evidence
